name: Experiments on a system determine experiments on its homomorphisms
description: Theorem 4.22: if Z1 = HIMSY(Z2, HS, HI, HO) and (f, x, t) ∈ EXZ2, then (HI ∘ f, HS(x), t) ∈ EXZ1, HS(STZ2(f,x)(t)) = STZ1(HI∘f, HS(x))(t), HS ∘ STZ2(f,x) = STZ1(HI∘f, HS(x)), and HO ∘ OTZ2(f,x) = OTZ1(HI∘f, HS(x)).

elements.text: The image experiment (HI ∘ f, HS(x), t) ∈ EXZ1 of an experiment (f, x, t) ∈ EXZ2.
An experiment on Z2 determines an experiment on Z1 whose state and output trajectories are the HS/HO images.
